title: The Shrine of Illusions
wikitext:
[[File:The Shrine of Illusions.png|thumb|The Shrine of Illusions]]
'''The Shrine of Illusions''' is an altar found in the basement of the [[Wizard's Tower]]. [[The Player|The player]] can offer {{Price|500}} to the shrine to change their appearance, name, favorite thing, and gender.

The [[Wizard]]'s basement becomes accessible from a trapdoor in his house when the player has at least [[Friendship|four hearts]] with him. It can also be accessed through a red portal in the [[Witch's Hut]] as soon as the Witch's Hut is accessible.

==Trivia==
* Changing the character's name to include item spawn codes [[Secrets#Shrine of Illusions|triggers an Easter egg]].
* Changing the favorite thing to be "ConcernedApe" or anything containing "Stardew" [[Stardrop#Secret Text|gives special dialogue when collecting a stardrop]].

==History==
{{History|1.4|Added ability to change pet appearance. Removed shirts and pants color sliders in favor of [[Tailoring]] system.}}
{{History|1.5|The player can now also change their gender, name, and favorite thing.}}
{{History|1.6|Removed ability to change pet appearance; instead, pets are removed via [[Butterfly Powder]].}}
